form.label: Alert Detail
form.description: Triage one detection: what the rule was looking for, the event that matched it, and what else happened on that host at the time.

search.query: index=sigma_alerts $rule_tok$ $host_tok$ $sev_tok$ | lookup sigma_rules sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_technique_name, sigma_tactic_name, sigma_confidence, sigma_confidence_score, sigma_falsepositives, sigma_disposition, sigma_platform, sigma_source_url | eval when = strftime(sigma_first_seen, "%F %T"), seen_for = case(sigma_span_seconds <= 0, "a single event", sigma_span_seconds < 60, sigma_span_seconds." seconds", sigma_span_seconds < 3600, round(sigma_span_seconds/60,0)." minutes", 1==1, round(sigma_span_seconds/3600,1)." hours"), technique = if(sigma_technique_name="" OR isnull(sigma_technique_name), "no technique mapped", sigma_technique_name), tactic = if(sigma_tactic_name="" OR isnull(sigma_tactic_name), "unmapped", sigma_tactic_name), urgency = if(sigma_disposition="immediate", "act now", "trend") | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='CommandLine'>(?<evt_cmdline>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='Image'>(?<evt_image>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='ParentImage'>(?<evt_parent>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='User'>(?<evt_user>[^<]*)" | rex field=sigma_sample "Name='ParentCommandLine'>(?<evt_parentcmd>[^<]*)"
index=sigma_alerts | stats count by sigma_rule | sort - count
index=sigma_alerts | stats count by sigma_src_host | sort - count
| search technique!="no technique mapped" | stats dc(technique)
| eval r=case(sigma_level="critical",4,sigma_level="high",3,sigma_level="medium",2,1==1,1) | stats max(r) as r | eval v=case(r=4,"critical",r=3,"high",r=2,"medium",1==1,"low") | fields v

panel.title: Detections — select one to read the evidence

search.query: | table when, sigma_src_host, sigma_rule, technique, tactic, sigma_level, sigma_confidence, urgency, sigma_match_count, seen_for, sigma_src_sourcetype, sigma_rule_id, sigma_src_index, evt_cmdline, evt_image, evt_parent, evt_user, evt_parentcmd | rename when as "When", sigma_src_host as "Host", sigma_rule as "Rule", technique as "ATT&CK technique", tactic as "Tactic", sigma_level as "Severity", sigma_confidence as "Confidence", urgency as "Handling", sigma_match_count as "Events", seen_for as "Over", sigma_src_sourcetype as "Source type" | fields - sigma_rule_id, sigma_src_index, evt_* | sort - "When"

| search sigma_rule="$sel_rule$" sigma_src_host="$sel_host$" | head 1 | eval "Process"=coalesce(evt_image,"not in the sample"), "Command line"=coalesce(evt_cmdline,"not in the sample"), "Parent process"=coalesce(evt_parent,"not in the sample"), "Parent command line"=coalesce(evt_parentcmd,"not in the sample"), "User"=coalesce(evt_user,"not in the sample"), "Host"=sigma_src_host, "When"=when, "Matching events"=sigma_match_count." over ".seen_for, "Source type"=sigma_src_sourcetype, "Index"=sigma_src_index | fields "When","Host","User","Process","Command line","Parent process", "Parent command line","Matching events","Source type","Index" | transpose column_name="Field" | rename "row 1" as "Value"

panel.title: Why this rule fired, and what it gets wrong

search.query: | search sigma_rule="$sel_rule$" sigma_src_host="$sel_host$" | head 1 | lookup sigma_rule_logic sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_condition, sigma_description | eval "What it looks for"=coalesce(sigma_description,"no description"), "Sigma condition"=coalesce(sigma_condition,"unavailable"), "ATT&CK technique"=technique." (".sigma_attack.")", "Tactic"=tactic, "Confidence"=sigma_confidence." (".sigma_confidence_score."/100)", "Handling"=if(urgency="act now", "Alerts on a single match: this rule is both severe and specific.", "Recorded and baselined; its value is the pattern, not one occurrence."), "Known false positives"=if(sigma_falsepositives="", "The author declared none. That is not the same as there being none.", sigma_falsepositives) | fields "What it looks for","Sigma condition","ATT&CK technique","Tactic", "Confidence","Handling","Known false positives" | transpose column_name="Field" | rename "row 1" as "Value"

panel.title: The events behind it — on $sel_host$, around $sel_when$

search.query: index=sigma_alerts sigma_src_host="$sel_host$" | lookup sigma_rules sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_technique_name | eval when=strftime(sigma_first_seen,"%F %T"), technique=if(sigma_technique_name="","no technique mapped",sigma_technique_name) | table when, sigma_rule, technique, sigma_level, sigma_match_count | rename when as "When", sigma_rule as "Rule", technique as "Technique", sigma_level as "Severity", sigma_match_count as "Events" | sort - "When"

html.div: Select a detection above to read the event that triggered it, what the rule was looking for, and what else happened on that host.
